title: Book One · Chapter 34: The Bell
story:
Mum wants to wipe the low shelf. She asks Ronan to move his things. The kite is on its board, and the book is back in its usual place. There is dust around the little wooden boat.

Ronan moves the boat first. One end is still green. He puts it on the bed and brings the red-sail book beside it.

Then he lifts the bell.

He last pressed it several days ago. The metal feels cool. There is a small line of dust under the thumb piece.

He wipes it with the edge of his cloth. Then he rings it once.

Mum looks in from the kitchen. "Dinner already?"

"No. I'm cleaning my bell."

"A very noisy cloth."

Ronan smiles and rings it again. This time Mrs Lan calls from the front room.

"Is that for me?"

He goes to tell her it is only his old bike bell. She asks to hear it close up. He holds it out, and she presses it with one careful finger.

"A good clear sound," she says. "I thought someone was selling something at the gate."

Ronan brings it back. Dad is at the table. He puts two kinds of screws into separate old lids. The bell rings a third time. Dad looks up.

"I remember that sound," he says.

"Bo hasn't got it."

"No. You have it."

"His bike has my mark."

"We sold the bike with that mark on its wheel."

Ronan sits beside him. Dad moves the screw lids away from the edge. They aren't toys, but Ronan may watch.

"Do you want the bike back?" Ronan asks.

Dad rests both hands on the table.

"Yes. I want it back too."

"But can we ask Bo for it?"

"No. It belongs to him now."

Ronan turns the bell over. There is an empty space under the bell. The handlebar used to fit there.

"Bo tried the pedal. I showed him with my hand."

"I saw."

"I didn't let him have this."

"You didn't need to."

Dad gives him a small square of clean soft cloth. Mum said they could use this piece. Ronan puts it around the bell. He leaves the thumb piece outside. Now the boat and bell will not scratch each other. Both will go on the small shelf.

Leo comes to return the test pencil. He sees the bell on the table.

"Does your kite need that?" he asks.

"So people get out of the sky?" Ronan says.

Leo presses it. The bell makes a clear, loud sound. Mum looks over from the window. Leo smiles and gives the bell back.

They try ringing it through the cloth. The sound becomes dull. Ronan unwraps the top again.

"Not all covered," he says.

The shelf is dry now. He puts the boat back, then the book. Dad checks two small nails. Mum uses them to hang the old-house drawing. It goes above Ronan's bed. The picture is low enough for him to touch the tree.

He places the bell on the shelf below it. The tea box stays by his bed. These are different places for different things now.

He looks once at the drawing. Then he goes out to play. In the drawing, the red bicycle is still under the old tree. He doesn't add a kite to the sky. The new kite is real, and there is room for it beside the door.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：cloth＝布；rings＝使铃响；soft＝柔软的；once＝一次。

理解问题：

1. 车铃这次出现在哪个新的情境？
2. Dad 和 Ronan 怎样谈到旧自行车？
